silhouette.reason: Original VTOL dropship: lofted nose with framed canopy, slab cabin with rear ramp, two tilting ducted nacelles on sponsons, swept tail and fin, landing gear. Distinct and readable from every view and at LOD2.
fixes: a deeper chin or sensor blister under the nose so the FRONT view is less of a plain oval

proportions.reason: Design dossier scale (cabin fits troops at 1.8 m, ramp at walking slope) and envelope pass; nacelles in proportion to the hull.
fixes: shorten the tail boom ~0.5 m so the nacelles sit nearer the centre of mass in SIDE

materials.reason: Steel-painted hull with chips, aluminium mechanisms, glass canopy, glowing lights, hazard and accent paint. In hero.png the left canopy pane shows a patch of white speckle noise, the nose loft shows triangle faceting in the shading, and the chip pattern is uniform and dense on the large plates.
fixes: find and remove the white speckle on the canopy pane (glass coplanar with the frame/interior, or grime on glass)
weighted normals on the nose loft
lower chip density on big plates (a defined steel_painted variant)

detail.reason: Plate seams, vents and louvres, greebles, antennae, hatches, stencils and tail number, gear with pads, nacelle hazard rings and louvres, cabin interior.
fixes: rivet/fastener rows along the plate seams
hydraulic lines on the gear legs

wear.reason: Chipped paint everywhere, dirt on gear and belly, dust on top. No exhaust scorch around the nacelles, no oil streaks, no faded stencils.
fixes: heat scorch inside and below the nacelle mouths
oil streaks from the gear bays

lod.reason: LOD2 (2 000) keeps hull, canopy, nacelles, wings, tail and gear; the nacelle hazard rings, tail number and window row drop, so the strongest colour accents vanish at distance.
fixes: keep the nacelle hazard rings and the 07 as flat quads at LOD2

technical.reason: QA PASS, 18 766 / 6 458 / 2 002; glow rules, ramp arc check, moving nacelles and ramp clear; connections gate clean.
fixes: split only faces taller than one strip band in the UV pass
